data.narrative:
Sunday Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Tony Zhao and Cheng Chi that has raised $200M to date. The comparable universe consists of one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using the $200M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $500M. The Peer-Median approach is not applicable due to insufficient comparable density: while eight same-sector peers exist, only one operates at the same stage, and zero adjacent-stage or similar-tier comparables meet the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median derivation.

The triangulated valuation range is $425M–$575M, with a median of $500M. This single-method triangulation carries material uncertainty. The range incorporates typical variance around stage-progression multipliers but lacks cross-validation from peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.5x step-up assumption for Sunday's specific technology and market position, and whether the $200M raised proxy accurately reflects enterprise value. Additional comps or disclosed financials would strengthen conviction in this range.
